Write the comparison as JSON

Source: R/report.R
write_dossier_json.Rd

The JSON holds everything the report shows, as data. Its JSON Schema ships with the package: system.file("schema", "dossier.schema.json", package = "pkgdossier"). Its top level:

Usage

write_dossier_json(x, path)

Arguments

x

An pkgdossier_comparison from compare_runs().

path

File to write; its folder is created if needed.

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

  • schema ("pkgdossier") and schema_version ("0.1.0");

  • meta: package, version labels, the provenance of both versions (as recorded by prepare_versions()), the run plan, the environment of the first run of each version (R version, dependency versions, machine, seed, repeats), machine load, the determinism check, the comparison's tolerances, and news (the NEWS file read, a note, and the bullets after the baseline's version);

  • differences: one record per labelled difference, with the columns of differences(); differences_grouped: one record per distinct change, as differences(group = TRUE);

  • scenarios: per scenario its id, title, source, notes, not_run chunks and steps. Each step holds status, kinds, the code, both versions' errors (error, error_class), warnings, console transcript, line diffs (transcript_diff, printed_diff: rows of [op, base, cand] with op =, ~, - or +), values (numbers compared, changed, tiny, only on one side), struct (element paths only in one version), time (median, min, max and number of timings per version), plot (whether the images differ, and the image files relative to the work folder), news (candidate NEWS bullets) and news_functions (the package functions the step uses).

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
json <- write_dossier_json(cmp, file.path(tempdir(), "dossier.json"))
names(jsonlite::fromJSON(json, simplifyVector = FALSE))
#> [1] "schema"              "schema_version"      "meta"               
#> [4] "differences"         "differences_grouped" "scenarios"          
# }
